full_prompt_en: A square landscape image shows an open meadow rolling toward distant blue hills beneath an expansive sunset sky. The sky fills more than half the frame, beginning with dark blue-violet cloud masses at the upper right and upper left. Broken turquoise openings and magenta streaks run between them. Toward the center, the cloud layers stretch horizontally, their lower edges lit orange and warm rose. A broad golden glow gathers just above the low horizon at the center, grading through coral and peach near the land. Below it, a gently sloping field sweeps down from the left toward the right. Sunlit yellow-green grass forms broad diagonal bands across the middle ground, interleaved with quieter violet and ocher strips. A large, rounded dark green tree stands on the left rise, its trunk and foliage outlined against the brighter strip of sky. Smaller trees or shrubs recede through the center toward the base of the hills, each reduced to a compact dark silhouette. On the right, the hills form several overlapping blue and teal ridges, their lit planes crossed by narrow warm grassy bands. Across the lower third, a dense foreground of lavender-purple flowering grasses and brown-gold seed heads fills the frame. Their thin blades remain individually visible at the bottom edge, while more distant patches merge into soft color. A small dark rock or low clump interrupts the violet growth near the lower left. No buildings or people break the wide view, and no readable marks appear. The image has a heightened photographic or digitally worked clarity, with the land rendered as textured grass and the sky as layered, flowing cloud. The strongest light comes from the setting sun near the central horizon, spreading orange along cloud undersides and throwing long warm glances across the meadow. The foreground stays comparatively dark and cool, which makes the glowing middle bands and sky more vivid. The overall composition is broad and calm but chromatically dramatic, balancing flowing violet-blue clouds with gold field stripes and a textured purple foreground.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形风景图像呈现开阔草甸向远处蓝色山丘起伏延伸，头顶铺展辽阔的落日天空。天空占据画面一半以上，上方左右两侧是深蓝紫色云团，其间露出破碎的绿松石色空隙与品红色云纹。靠近中央，云层横向伸展，下缘被橙色与暖玫瑰色照亮。宽阔的金色亮光聚集在中央低矮的地平线上方，靠近土地处渐变成珊瑚色与桃色。下方，一片缓坡草地从左侧向右方铺展。受阳光照亮的黄绿色草形成横贯中景的宽斜带，其间交错较平静的紫色与赭色条纹。左侧坡上立着一棵圆冠深绿大树，树干与树冠在较亮天空前显出轮廓。较小的树或灌木沿中央退向山脚，各自缩成紧凑的深色剪影。右侧，山丘形成数道重叠的蓝色和青绿色山脊，受光坡面被窄窄的暖色草带穿过。下方三分之一处，密集的薰衣草紫色花草和褐金色草穗填满前景。下边缘处能分辨细长草叶，远处的斑块则融为柔和色彩。左下附近，一块小暗石或低矮草丛打断紫色植被。开阔视野中没有建筑或人物，也没有可读的标记。画面有强化的摄影式或数字处理清晰感，土地显出草本肌理，天空则由流动的层叠云组成。最强的光来自中央地平线附近的落日，使云底染橙，并沿草甸投出长长的暖亮带。前景相比之下较暗且偏冷，让发光的中景色带与天空更鲜明。整体构图宽阔平静而色彩戏剧化，以流动的紫蓝云层平衡金色草地条纹与有肌理的紫色前景。
style_prompt_en: The landscape treatment heightens natural color into saturated violet, magenta, turquoise, coral orange, and glowing gold, while retaining recognizable textures. Broad horizontal cloud bands and diagonal ground strips create a layered, sweeping rhythm. Warm backlight gathers low in the frame, illuminating undersides and selected edges, while near surfaces remain cooler and darker. Small dark silhouettes punctuate large open color fields and make the distance legible. Fine organic texture in the nearest planes gives way to smoother bands farther back, strengthening atmospheric depth. The sky combines soft gradients with broken high-contrast streaks rather than one uniform wash. The overall effect is expansive and luminous, with a vivid warm-cool exchange and carefully controlled visual movement.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风景表现把自然色彩提升为饱和的紫罗兰、品红、绿松石、珊瑚橙与发光金色，同时保留可辨认的真实肌理。宽阔横向云带与斜向地表条纹形成层叠而铺展的节奏。暖逆光汇聚在画面低处，照亮下侧与选定边缘，近处表面则较冷较暗。小面积深色剪影点缀大片开放色域，使距离关系清晰。最近平面的细密有机肌理在远处渐变为较平滑的色带，加强大气纵深。天空把柔和渐层与破碎的高对比色纹结合，而非均一铺色。整体效果开阔明亮，暖冷色交换鲜明，视觉流动得到细致控制。
theme_en: A violet meadow beneath a vivid sunset sky and distant blue hills
theme_zh: 鲜艳落日天空与远处蓝色山丘下的紫色草甸
name: Kevin McNeal
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
